title: DmNx FONTS
features:
🔱 Visual & UI Framework
Dynamic Intro Screen: Displays a fully customized layout referencing your identity (DmNx Ji) with integrated avatar fetching system logic matching image_c24518.jpg.

Dual UI Navigation Toggles: Full menu access control mapped universally to the M key, combined with an on-screen floating master-neon shortcut button (🔱).

Premium Sleek Interface Palette: Built on a strict dark palette (Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)) paired with dynamic UIStroke neon-green custom styling layouts.

Automated UI Drag Engine: Built-in seamless cursor capture processing allowing you to position the script interface anywhere on your viewport without glitching.

Ambient Particle Matrix: Background particle renderer that spawns floating, fading neon nodes to elevate the engine aesthetic.

🔠 Text & Font Manipulation Core
12-Preset Font Vector Maps: Multi-font encryption libraries including:

Cyrillic & Modified Cyrillic (🕷️ / ⚡ / ✝ variants)

Greek Text Map Styles (💎)

SmallCaps Layouts (🌸 / 💥 / 🏴‍☠️)

Thai Symbols Engine (♬ / ⚔)

Square & Bubble Unicode Frames (🚀 / 🎀)

Japan Aesthetic Blocks (🔥)
